shortDescription: List and filter on Logs Stream History.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Logs Stream History to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Logs Stream History.

options.name: id
options.description: The parent ID for the Logs Stream History.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Logs Stream History in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Logs Stream History by.
